# Cask Code - SMWS distillery code lookup

> Independent, community-sourced reference that decodes Scotch Malt Whisky Society (SMWS) cask codes to their distillery and region, with the current Outturn releases. Not affiliated with SMWS. Buy bottles or join at https://smws.com

Open data (CC BY 4.0): https://caskcode.co.uk/data/smws-codes.json

## How SMWS codes work

An SMWS code like 4.403 means distillery 4 (before the dot) and cask 403 (after the dot). SMWS does not print distillery names on its labels.
